_comment: P1 frozen primary arm. Pinned by the Master Agent 2026-09-29 (docs/CLUSTER_DECISION.md) on Sub-agent C's measurements. Changing any field here creates a NEW experimental arm; it is never a backfill.

reader._model_note: BARE name on Metis. Sophia requires 'openai/gpt-oss-120b'. These are NOT normalised to each other: they are separate arms.
reader._max_tokens_note: Reasoning tokens are drawn from this same budget. A 256-token answer needs >=512 or the call returns finish_reason='length' with null content, which the client raises on rather than scoring (see docs/ENDPOINT_THROUGHPUT.md and report C1.4).

failover_arm._comment: SEPARATE ARM. Never pooled with the primary. Use only if Metis fails, and label the results distinctly.
failover_arm._caveat: Sophia omits completion_tokens_details, so reasoning-token accounting is NOT available on this arm.

embeddings._verified: dim 4096 and cos=1.000000 on identical text, re-measured live 2026-09-29.
embeddings._do_not_use: google/embeddinggemma-300m is advertised on Sophia and returns 502.

concurrency._justification: Highest level with zero failures of any kind across 316 requests (docs/ENDPOINT_THROUGHPUT.md). HTTP 429 appears at 24 and 32 workers. Sustained 6-wave run at 16: 5.690 req/s, 341.4 completions/min, p50 2.588s, p95 4.392s, 0% errors.
concurrency._ceiling_caveat: Measured 2026-09-29 17:53-17:56 UTC on a shared gateway from one laptop. This is an observed ceiling, not a service guarantee; the client must handle 429 regardless.

retry._retry_after_note: Metis 429s carried NO Retry-After header, so the jittered-exponential path is what actually runs. The header is still honoured if one appears.

known_dead.minerva/gpt-oss-120b: HTTP 503 'not currently live on Minerva', reproduced 4x on 2026-09-29. Advertised by /resource_server/minerva/models but does not serve.
known_dead.tara: listed by list-endpoints with empty frameworks; no models.
